They are dropped by [[Stalmoblin]]s after being defeated by [[Link]]. They can be used as two-handed [[Weapon]]s, but are very brittle and will easily break. Moblin Arms are made of bone, which means they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during a [[Thunderstorm]], can not be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], and will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].
